objetivo: Share a short personal memory using simple past language.

parejas.a: Can you share a good memory?
parejas.b: Sure. I remember a nice day last month. I visited my cousin.
We went to a café. We talked for a long time and took some photos.

parejas.a: Why is it a good memory?
parejas.b: Because we had a great time together. I really ___ that day.
